description: Reward-program valuation table for catalog v3 (Phase 7 Stage 2 M3). One program per reward currency; every expansion.v1 and real.v2.2 card maps to one program with a verbatim currency anchor of at most 25 words from its capture. Values are hundredths of a cent per unit: cash back 100; published estimates from one primary publisher (for bank currencies its baseline value, which is the issuer’s own travel-portal or fixed value, not a transfer value and not always the cash value; for airline and hotel currencies its median program value); otherwise an issuer-stated fixed redemption value from the captures, including credit toward the program’s own travel, cruise or store purchases (broader than corpus conventions 3 and 20, which govern card point values only; gift-card and up-to values excluded); otherwise none (no value is assumed). Card statedValueHundredthsOfCent repeats the corpus pointValueHundredthsOfCent and takes precedence over the program value. Numbers, URLs and dates only from the publisher.
